'''Oorn Tchis''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] near [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was a small, backrocket rural world best known for exporting colorful fabrics and a rare [[Ore/Legends|ore]] used in guidance system design.<ref name="XW" /><ref name="CET" />

On the eve of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NC" /> the entire [[Lahara sector/Legends|Lahara sector]], which contained 245 settled worlds that mostly produced agricultural products,<ref name="HNW">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|50|news/1344_4.html|Lahara Sector Secedes}}</ref><ref name="CEL">{{CSWECite|II|241|Lahara sector}}</ref> joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], bringing with it the planets [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]] and Oorn Tchis, as well as the [[Mirgoshir hyperspace crossroads]].<ref name="NC" /> With the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the sector submitted to the new government. [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] sent his [[Kitha Farlander|sister]] to Oorn Tchis to live with relatives after their family lost their home on Agamar.<ref name="XW" />
